# WarDOGE

> WarDOGE is a free, open-source multiplayer browser game at https://wardoge.io. It is a top-down team shooter in the style of agar.io, with Doge-meme soldiers.

## How it plays
- Three teams (Red, Blue, Green), 15 slots each. Bots fill empty slots and real players replace them.
- Capture and hold the Hot Zone in the middle of the map to score. Buy guns, armor, grenades and medkits between rounds.
- Play as a guest or sign in with Google to save progress. No download; works on desktop and mobile browsers.

## Links
- Play: https://wardoge.io/
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/EvsenevDev/wardoge
